name: Jellyfin
description: Stream your movies, shows and music to any device. Reads cold storage (read-only).
compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8096"
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - {DATA}/cache:/cache
      - /mnt/cold_storage:/media:ro
